description: IPC surface for the LOCAL wizard pages only. `local: true` means these permissions apply only while the window shows tauri:// content; once the main window navigates to the remote loopback backend, none of this applies, so the backend SPA cannot invoke Rust. Only `core:default` is granted — every plugin (opener/dialog/store) is used exclusively from guarded Rust commands, so we deliberately do NOT expose those plugin commands to the webview (that would let a page bypass the command-level allowlist checks).
